findings.summary: The rationale in the test comment and at contract :74 ('the d.ts bundle keeps a `declare global` only from an entry module') is inaccurate. The bundle keeps a non-entry module's global when that module contributes public types. fs-errors.ts was dropped because it exports only values that never reach fs's public d.ts. The carrier's pass is correct, since the published d.ts stays valid, so only the explanatory text is imprecise.
